display.purpose: Page titles and card section headers, Space Grotesk 700-800.

body.purpose: Copy, labels, member names, form inputs, Space Grotesk 500-600.

stat.purpose: Every score, streak, drink count, or rank -- IBM Plex Mono, tabular-nums, never used for incidental numbers.

motion.name: none-yet
motion.purpose: No motion system implemented yet -- current UI is fully static. Candidate for an `/impeccable animate` pass: button press feedback, points-earned pop, streak-fill, page transitions.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Only defined breakpoint today -- the app is designed mobile-first/mobile-only, no desktop layout exists yet.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one loud call-to-action per screen -- form submits, +1 drink, confirm actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; background: #c8ff4d; color: #0a0c10; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b3e645; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c8ff4d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Violet outline button for a secondary action beside a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 20px; min-height: 44px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; background: transparent; color: #7a6ff0; border: 1px solid rgba(122,111,240,0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(122,111,240,0.1); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base surface every feature widget sits on -- flat, hairline border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: #15181f; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #f2f3f5; margin: 0; }

components.name: Pill Badge - Lime
components.description: Positive/primary-emphasis chip -- streak counters, level badges, rank-1 highlight.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pill-lime { background: rgba(200,255,77,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(200,255,77,0.4); color: #c8ff4d; }

components.name: Pill Badge - Violet
components.description: "This is you" chip -- current member's identity marker, never combined with lime meaning in the same view.
components.css: .ds-pill-violet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: rgba(122,111,240,0.16); border: 1px solid rgba(122,111,240,0.45); color: #ada7f1; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation Item
components.description: One of five persistent nav items; active state gets a lime blob-radius icon well.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; min-width: 44px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-icon-well { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 34px; border-radius: 45% 55% 60% 40% / 60% 40% 60% 40%; font-size: 14px; } .ds-nav-icon-well--active { background: rgba(200,255,77,0.14); color: #c8ff4d; } .ds-nav-icon-well--inactive { color: #4a505c; } .ds-nav-label { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-label--active { color: #c8ff4d; } .ds-nav-label--inactive { color: #4a505c; }

components.name: Stat Number
components.description: Signature component: every score/streak/drink-count/rank renders through this, IBM Plex Mono + tabular-nums, so numbers read as 'the scoreboard' against the Space Grotesk UI around them.
components.css: .ds-stat-number { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; color: #f2f3f5; }

narrative.overview: A friend group's trip companion that feels like a handheld arcade cabinet built for one specific inside joke, not a fitness-tracker reskin. The system lives almost entirely in the dark: a near-black ink surface hosts a single loud accent (glow-stick lime) doing the talking, with a second, quieter neon (dusk violet) reserved for "this is you" / secondary-emphasis moments. Numbers get a monospace, HUD-style treatment so points, streaks, and drink counts read like a scoreboard, not a form field. Structure stays clean and rectilinear (pill buttons, 16px-radius cards), but accents break the grid on purpose: level badges, rank-1 chips, and icon wells use an organic, slightly lopsided "blob" radius and a small counter-rotation, so the interface feels hand-placed rather than machine-generated. No drop shadows anywhere; depth comes from tonal layering (ink to panel to panel-hover) and soft, blurred glow blooms behind key moments.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black base with exactly one dominant accent (lime) and one supporting accent (violet)
Monospace numerals for every stat, score, and count
Flat surfaces + tonal layering + soft glow blooms instead of shadows
Clean rectilinear structure, organic "blob" radius reserved for accent/celebration moments
Small, deliberate counter-rotations (-10deg to 4deg) on badges and chips for handmade energy

rules.name: The One-Loud-Color Rule
rules.body: Only one saturated accent is ever "the point" of a given element. Lime and violet never both call for attention in the same component; when a view needs both, they must be on different rows so the eye resolves them as two separate facts.

rules.name: The Scoreboard Rule
rules.body: If a number is something the group is competing over or tracking (points, streak days, drink counts, rank), it renders in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums. If a number is incidental (a date, a PIN field, a percentage in body copy), it stays in Space Grotesk.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow anywhere in the system. Depth is conveyed by tonal layering and soft glow blooms, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep exactly one saturated accent doing the "this is the point" job per component (The One-Loud-Color Rule).
Do render every score/count/rank in IBM Plex Mono with tabular-nums (The Scoreboard Rule).
Do reserve the blob radius + counter-rotation combo for small accent moments, never full cards or page sections.
Do convey depth with tonal steps and glow blooms, never box-shadow.
Do keep tap targets at 44px+ given the sunlight/one-handed/post-a-few-drinks usage context.
donts: Don't use emoji as iconography; every icon is a hand-authored inline SVG on a 20px stroke-based grid.
Don't introduce a gradient background/hero, a left-border-accent card, or any other templated-AI-tool visual tell.
Don't let lime and violet both carry "primary emphasis" in the same view.
Don't add a box-shadow to lift anything on hover/press; change tone or add a glow instead.
Don't fall back to Arial/Inter/Roboto/system-ui as a visible font; those exist only as the fallback stack behind Space Grotesk / IBM Plex Mono.
